metadata.legal_basis: CDER Manual of Policies and Procedures (internal FDA review procedure). Informative; not binding on applicants.

Scans, tables, other languages and implicit obligations may be missed. Zero candidates does not establish zero requirements.

candidates.statement: • An officer can be nominated for an award for an accomplishment not previously recognized. The award must be formally initiated within 13 months after the period covered ending dated.
candidates.context: • A fellow officer, co-worker, superior, or someone outside the PHS with knowledge of the accomplishment(s) deserving recognition may initiate the nomination of an officer or a group of officers as candidate(s) for an individual or unit award. • All award nominations require the 1 st supervisory/line authority signatures within 90 days of the nomination date.
